scope: Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Chapter 6: Fiscal constraints. The present-value Laffer curve with exact elasticities; discount rates and growth (r = delta + gamma g); the Miller crash model with both regimes and comparative statics; the debt-to-GDP equation and the r versus g dichotomy (r > g: the present value is the unique bounded solution; r < g: indeterminacy, not infinity; temporary r < g restores uniqueness), continuous and discrete; a stochastic debt limit via Borel-Cantelli; growth-theory transversality; money and liquidity; return discounting; aggregate uncertainty and Bohn's example with corrected lognormal formulas. Printed errors corrected with Lean counterexamples.
source: John H. Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Princeton University Press, Chapter 6, pp. 187-211.
